review: ORBIT 2.4 retained V6/M1 immutable provenance; BP-02 portable private media backup, EX-00 safe scene adapter, and EX-01 official Excalidraw lazy React island from exact pinned npm lockfile. No hosted database migration or Production alias change. BP-03 focused hidden-tab read reduction on a separate source branch, with existing CAS and owner isolation unchanged. PJ-02A exposes reversible private branch-project actions via accessible unscaled menu; original V6 spatial coordinates and public projection remain untouched. PJ-02B adds the functional private Projects window and synthetic eighth test fixture; no public project projection or hosted migration. PJ-02B visual audit of synthetic desktop/phone screenshots moved the new shelf away from the active rail and increased phone text legibility by reducing default first-party width. BP-07 WIP recovered on top of main; fixes mount/render crash, deferred editor writes, private media and navigation transitions, and in-place Excalidraw. No production or hosted schema changes. BP-14 client-only iCalendar export; no OAuth, provider integration, schema or media changes. BP-08 optional Focus mode stores the camera in memory only, with inert peripheral widgets and exact reversible camera; no spatial coordinate/schema migrations. BP-09 owned detached snapshot path removes one clone per live owner update; default queue still clones, and repository boundary still clones before save.
